--- Interfaces
1: lo: <LOOPBACK>
    inet 127.0.0.1/8 scope host lo
2: eth0: <UP>
    inet 10.0.0.5/24

--- resolv.conf

--- systemd-resolved

  Protocols: +LLMNR

--- Netplan

  version: 2
--- interfaces (legacy)

--- dhcpcd
hostname
